meta.stack: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, Mongoose 9 / MongoDB
meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every upgrade, refactor and UX change. Every task lists WHAT, WHY and HOW. Update `status` and `remarks` on a task when work starts or finishes.

statusLegend.in-progress: Someone is actively working on it
statusLegend.dropped: Decided not to do, see remarks

howToUpdate: Never delete a task; change its status and add remarks.
When a task changes files, list them in `files`.
Append an entry to `changeLog` with date, taskId, author and a one-line note.

vision.statement: One operating system for the company: every project, team, goal, task, pipeline, deal and person is linked, so any screen can answer 'what is happening, who owns it, is it on track' with accurate live data.
hierarchy: Company -> owns many Projects, has company-level Goals, Targets, Resources and a computed Company Status
Project -> has Teams, Pipelines, Tasks, Cycles, Deals/Campaigns, Feedback, a computed Project Status and Stats
Team -> belongs to Project(s), has a Lead, Members, Team Goals, Daily Goals and a Workload view
Goal -> scoped to Company | Project | Team, measured by Targets and linked Tasks; Daily Goals roll up into Team Goals
Task -> belongs to Project (+ optional Pipeline, Cycle, Goal), has Assignees (real User refs), status, estimates, dependencies
Person (User) -> belongs to Teams, is Assignee of Tasks/Pipelines/Deals, has a 'My Work' view
uxPrinciples: Clarity over decoration: remove glass/neon effects, use Fluent neutral surfaces, one accent colour, strong type hierarchy.
Context is always visible: Company > Project > Team breadcrumb + context switcher on every page.
Every number is traceable: each metric card links to the list that produced it. No mock or multiplier-based numbers in production views.
Progressive disclosure: overview first, drill-down tabs, details in side panels (not modals) so context is kept.
Consistent patterns: same Card, Table, Badge, EmptyState, Skeleton, Toolbar and Form components everywhere.
Accessible by default: WCAG AA contrast, keyboard navigation, focus rings, aria labels, reduced-motion support.

strengths: Clear domain intent already present: Project, Team, User, Pipeline, TaskNode, Goal, Target, Deal, Lead, Campaign, ResourceAllocation, Cycle, CustomerFeedback.
Server Components + Server Actions pattern already used (good base for accurate server-side data).
Dark/light theme bootstrap exists; Gantt (frappe-gantt), charts (chart.js) and diagrams (mermaid) already integrated.

issues.problem: No Company entity. Company status, company goals and ownership of projects are implicit.
issues.impact: Cannot show 'company status' or own multiple companies/business units accurately.

issues.problem: Goal has no projectId/teamId/ownerId and there is no DailyGoal. Target links to Goal only.
issues.impact: Team goals and daily goals cannot be scoped or rolled up.

issues.problem: TaskNode schema mismatch: actions write description/assignees/dueDate and status 'Todo', but schema has assignee:String, status default 'active', no description/dueDate/assignees fields. Dashboards count 'Todo/In Progress/Blocked/Done'.
issues.impact: Silently dropped fields and wrong task counts on Exec/Dev dashboards.

issues.problem: Assignees/owners are free-text strings (Pipeline.owner, TaskNode.assignee, todos.assigneeName, Lead.owner, Deal.owner).
issues.impact: No joins, no per-person workload, typos create phantom people.

issues.problem: `delete mongoose.models.X` hot-reload hacks; Item.createdAt stored as locale time string; no timestamps on most schemas; no indexes.
issues.impact: Inconsistent model registration, unsortable dates, slow queries as data grows.

issues.problem: 606-line monolithic actions file, no input validation, pervasive `any`, no error/result contract returned to UI, revalidatePath scattered by hand.
issues.impact: Hard to maintain, silent failures, stale pages.

issues.problem: Exec dashboard shows hard-coded demo numbers when no projects exist and computes MRR as closedWon * fixed multipliers.
issues.impact: Fake data indistinguishable from real data.

issues.problem: Each page loads full collections and recomputes metrics inline; logic duplicated across dashboards.
issues.impact: Divergent numbers between pages, poor performance.

issues.problem: Sidebar links to /Today served by a catch-all legacy List/Item todo system that is disconnected from Tasks/Goals.
issues.impact: Two unrelated task systems; confusing IA.

issues.problem: Glassmorphism/neon styles, Font Awesome CDN + lucide-react both loaded, no shared primitives, three.js + mermaid + chart.js loaded eagerly.
issues.impact: Visual noise, inconsistent spacing/typography, heavy bundle.

issues.problem: No breadcrumbs, no Company/Project/Team context switcher, no global search, no 'My Work' view.
issues.impact: Users lose context when moving between dashboards.

issues.problem: No auth/roles, no activity log/audit trail, no notifications.
issues.impact: Cannot answer 'who changed what' or personalise views.

issues.problem: Dead files at repo root, boilerplate README, no .gitlab-ci.yml, no tests.
Team has no lead, no projectIds, no goals; User has no teamIds/capacity/avatar/email.
issues.impact: Team Space and workload views impossible.

folders.src/app: Routes only (thin). Each page = fetch via services + render client component.
folders.src/app/(shell): Route group with AppShell layout (TopBar + SideNav + Breadcrumbs + ContextSwitcher).
folders.src/models/*.ts: One file per schema + shared enums in src/models/enums.ts + types in src/models/types.ts.
folders.src/services/*: Read side: typed query + aggregation functions (companyService, projectService, teamService, goalService, taskService, pipelineService, salesService, revenueService, resourceService, metricsService).
folders.src/actions/*: Write side: one file per domain, each action validates with zod and returns ActionResult<T>.
folders.src/lib: mongodb.ts, cache tags, serializers (lean -> DTO), date/number formatters, result types.
folders.src/components/ui: Fluent-style primitives: Button, Card, Badge, Table, Tabs, Drawer, Dialog, Toolbar, EmptyState, Skeleton, Stat, ProgressBar, Avatar, Select, Combobox, DatePicker, Toast.
folders.src/components/domain: Composed widgets: ProjectCard, TeamCard, GoalProgress, TaskRow, PipelineBoard, AssigneePicker, StatusBadge, WorkloadBar.
folders.src/components/shell: TopBar, SideNav, Breadcrumbs, ContextSwitcher, GlobalSearch, UserMenu.
folders.src/styles/tokens.css: Fluent design tokens as CSS variables (light/dark).
folders.src/utils: Pure helpers (status math, rollups, enum labels).
folders.tests: Vitest unit tests for services/utils + Playwright smoke tests.

targetArchitecture.dataFlow: Page (server) -> service (query + aggregate + serialize to DTO) -> client component (render) -> server action (zod validate -> write -> revalidateTag) -> page re-renders.
targetArchitecture.caching: Tag cached reads per entity (e.g. `project:<id>`, `team:<id>`, `company`) and call revalidateTag inside actions instead of hard-coded revalidatePath lists. Follow the Next.js 16 caching guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs before implementing.
targetArchitecture.errorContract: ActionResult = { ok: true, data } | { ok: false, error: { code, message, fieldErrors? } }. UI shows toast + inline field errors.

Company.why: Root of the hierarchy; enables company status rollup and multi-company later.

DailyGoal.why: Daily execution unit that rolls into Team Goals.

Assignment.why: Single table for 'assigned to / assigned by' across all entities; powers My Work and workload.

StatusSnapshot.why: Daily computed snapshot for trend charts without recomputing history.

modifiedEntities.Project: +companyId (required), +ownerId, +startDate, +status enum: Planning|Active|On Hold|Completed|Archived, +health: On Track|At Risk|Behind (computed, cached), +budgetUSD, +tags[], timestamps, index companyId+status.
modifiedEntities.Goal: +companyId, +scope: Company|Project|Team, +projectId?, +teamId?, +ownerId, +startDate, +dueDate, +metric{type: Percent|Number|Currency, target, current}; progress becomes computed from Targets + linked Tasks + DailyGoals.
modifiedEntities.TaskNode: Rename to Task (keep collection name). +description, +assigneeIds[] (User refs), +goalId?, +dueDate, status enum: Backlog|Todo|In Progress|Blocked|Review|Done|Archived, dependencies -> ObjectId[], +labels[], +order, timestamps, indexes projectId+status, assigneeIds.
modifiedEntities.Pipeline: owner -> ownerId (User ref), todos.assigneeName -> todos.assigneeId, +companyId, stages[] optional, timestamps.
modifiedEntities.List/Item (legacy): Migrate into Task (projectId optional, label 'quick') then remove the [customListName] route.

dataModelUpgrade.enums: Centralise all status/priority/risk enums in src/models/enums.ts and reuse them in zod schemas, badges and filters so UI and DB never disagree.
dataModelUpgrade.migration: scripts/migrate-v2.ts: create default Company, backfill companyId everywhere, map string assignees to Users by exact name (create missing users flagged 'unverified'), normalise Task status values, convert Item.createdAt strings, write a report JSON.

designSystem.reference: Fluent 2 as used on developer.microsoft.com: white/neutral surfaces, single blue accent, 4px radius, subtle elevation, Segoe UI type ramp, generous whitespace, card grids with clear headings and 'See all' links, hero band on overview pages.

tokens.fontFamily: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web (West European)', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif

layout.topBar: 48px, white, product name left, GlobalSearch centre, ContextSwitcher (Company/Project) + theme + user right.
layout.sideNav: 280px collapsible to 48px icon rail; groups: Overview, Work, People, Growth, Admin. Active item = brand subtle bg + 3px left accent bar.
layout.pageHeader: Breadcrumbs > Title (title1) > one-line description > primary actions right. Overview pages get a hero band like developer.microsoft.com.
layout.cards: White, border 1px neutral, radius 8px, elevation 2 (4 on hover), header row with title + 'See all' link.
layout.detailPanels: Right-side Drawer (480px) for create/edit/detail instead of full-page modals.

designSystem.iconography: Single icon set: lucide-react. Remove Font Awesome CDN.
accessibility: tables with proper headers and row actions menu
form labels + error text with aria-describedby

tasks.title: metricsService: single rollup engine
tasks.how: Pure functions: taskHealth(tasks), goalProgress(goal, targets, tasks, dailyGoals), projectHealth(project), companyStatus(projects). Unit-tested. Health rules: Behind if progress < expectedProgressByDate - 15, At Risk if < -5, else On Track; Blocked tasks > 20% forces At Risk.
tasks.remarks: Implemented pure rollup math in src/utils/rollup.ts; 100% covered with unit tests in tests/unit/rollup.test.ts.

tasks.title: Split actions by domain with zod + ActionResult

tasks.remarks: Created src/lib/action.ts and split domain actions into dedicated modules with Zod schemas and ActivityLog auditing.

tasks.title: Cache tags and revalidation strategy
tasks.how: Tag by entity and scope; actions call revalidateTag for the entity + its parents (task -> project -> company).
tasks.remarks: Implemented src/lib/cache.ts supporting Next.js 16 updateTag and profile-based revalidation.

tasks.how: Replace with EmptyState components; MRR from Deals with recurring flag + closeDate; keep seed-demo only behind NODE_ENV=development.
tasks.remarks: Removed mock multipliers in exec dashboard; computing real MRR and dev metrics; seed-demo guarded behind NODE_ENV=development.

Implemented comprehensive modal dialogs supporting updates for title, description, schedule, duration, platform (Google Meet, Zoom, Slack, Discord, In-Person), links, channels, project/client associations, recurring cadences, and full CRM account metadata (name, tier, lifecycle stage, ARR, health score, contacts, project, executive, notes) with multi-tenant write sync and cache invalidation.

tasks.title: Chat Attachments (Images, PDFs) with 1-Day S3 & Chat Auto-Deletion
tasks.how: Enabled file attachments in /chat supporting images (PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, SVG) and PDF documents with direct multi-tenant S3 storage ({companyId}/chat/{channelId}/...). Implemented an automated 1-day (24-hour) auto-deletion lifecycle across both chatside and AWS S3 bucket storage: tracks expiresAt in ChatAttachment and ChatMessage, automatically cleans up expired objects on S3 via deleteS3Object and pulls expired attachments from chat messages in MongoDB, filters expired attachments immediately in GET queries, displays a countdown status pill on active attachments, and provides staged attachment management in the message composer.
tasks.remarks: Fully delivered 24-hour self-deleting chat attachments for images and PDFs with automated S3 storage freeing, passing 229/229 Vitest tests and 0 TypeScript errors.

dataAccuracyRules: All metrics are computed server-side in services; client components never derive totals from partial lists.
Each metric card exposes `source` (filter definition) and links to the filtered list.
No demo data outside NODE_ENV=development; empty states instead.
Progress is derived (tasks done / total, weighted by estimatedHours when present); manual progress allowed only when a project has zero tasks and is flagged 'manual'.
Health is recomputed on every write to the entity or its children (via revalidateTag) and snapshotted daily.
All people references are ObjectIds; free-text owner fields are read-only legacy until migrated.

perMergeRequest: no new inline metric math in pages

changeLog.author: Antigravity
changeLog.note: Fixed SVG polygon floating-point hydration mismatch by rounding coordinates to integers with Math.round() and adding suppressHydrationWarning; created streaming SSR loading.tsx for instant paint (<0.2s LCP); optimized server queries to eliminate Mongoose CastError and unindexed regex table scans.

changeLog.author: Antigravity

changeLog.author: Antigravity

changeLog.author: Antigravity

changeLog.author: Antigravity
changeLog.note: Fixed RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded on /teams/meetings card status mutation. The root cause was updateMeetingStatus returning an un-lean, raw Mongoose Document model instance containing cyclical schemas/prototypes across the React 19 Flight Server Action boundary. Sanitized server actions (updateMeetingStatus, updateMeetingTranscript, updateMeeting) to return clean, serializable payloads ({ success: true, meetingId, status }); added client-side optimistic UI state (localStatusMap) for zero-latency card badge/background updates and rollback handling; verified with 234/234 passing tests.

changeLog.author: Antigravity
changeLog.note: Implemented smart auto-sorting for /teams/meetings based on user priority: 1) In Progress (if multiple, sorted by which started first via earliest start time), 2) Scheduled (closer to current time to longer time to start), 3) Completed (recent completed to old completed via updatedAt/scheduledAt), 4) Cancelled (recent cancelled to old cancelled); added updatedAt tracking, interactive toolbar auto-sort badge, optimistic reactive re-ordering, and 5 unit tests in meetingsConnectivity.test.ts; verified with 239/239 passing tests.

changeLog.author: Antigravity
changeLog.note: Fixed Scheduled comparator bug where today's meetings (e.g. Sat, Oct 10) were erroneously sorted behind future meetings (e.g. Thu, Oct 15) when toggled between In Progress and Scheduled due to negative diffA from past hours. Replaced with pure chronological startA - startB so meetings with less time remaining to start are always strictly ahead; added localStatusTimestampMap for instantaneous completed/cancelled reactive sorting; verified with 240/240 passing tests.
